identity:
The testing mathematician was provided with a standard smartphone and instructed to turn on and leave on the flashlight, share their location with multiple provided addresses, and repeatedly delete and re-download several very large testing files (each over 10gb in size).  During breaks, the phone was left streaming HD movies over the cellular network.

Results were very consistent; while the phone's battery rapidly drained while unattended, despite not being connected to power, the battery slowly refilled when the phone was being handled by T47, often reaching or being close to 100% when the time came for a break.

Following this, the experiment was modified to have T47 sit and read a book in the same room, but never approach closer than two meters to the phone, which was again set to stream HD movies over the cellular network.  The phone discharged its battery and shut off completely within four hours.  Further testing shows the approximate range of the effect (in T47's case) to be 8 centimeters from their body and that barriers (both conductive and non-conductive) do not impede the effect in any way.  Attempts to use a multimeter to directly measure the strength of the effect were inconclusive, as it changed rapidly up to several times per second and often the multimeter simply could not register any current at all.  I have already submitted a request for further testing to determine the exact parameters of the effect, include its strength and the full variety of devices subject to it, and will submit an update with my results as soon as I have them.
-Charlotte Manning
Researcher

identity:
A roiling, rattling mass of ever-churning metal.  Flares of purple energy arc around the formless pile like electricity, and in their wake, thin metal rods and struts jut out, before disappearing into the half-molten heap which never seems to grow or diminish.  Its strange nature allows you to shift it around like furniture.

The power of this ore allows you to produce raw and basic metal items from material tokens via the crafting menu.
Just one of these could last forever.
